description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryMock for testing purposes, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides mock methods for creating various WebAudioPlayer tasks, used in unit tests for the Rialto server's media handling components.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory for testing WebAudioPlayer task creation.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a mock task for shutting down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a mock task for stopping the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a mock task for playing the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a mock task for pausing the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting the capabilities of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a mock task for signaling end-of-stream.

methods.name: createSetVolume
